notes: Version 2.2 records the finite S3 countermodel to the published Heisenberg carrier-selection argument. A faithful irreducible unitary carrier with a minimal involutively conjugate generating pair and a non-trivial commutator need not have a central commutator. The registry therefore reclassifies Found and HeisStr and treats the Heisenberg/Weil carrier as a supplied realisation. Results proved internally on that carrier retain their mathematical status. The interactive graph also introduces explicit edge types and renders synthesis links separately from derivational claims.
